title: Hugendubel tolino cyberattack, Nov 2026
disclaimer: Made for entertainment using AI. Not endorsed by Hugendubel, tolino, dpa, Golem.de, retail-news.de, Netzwelt, DerWesten, Handelsblatt, DIE ZEIT, DER SPIEGEL, BR24, Süddeutsche Zeitung, TAG24, LovelyBooks, ebook.de, Caschys Blog, F.A.Z., heise online, Börsenblatt, Thalia, any government agency, news outlet, company, or anyone else named.
size_basis: A major German bookseller with more than 100 stores has its web shop, service center, email and tolino e-book cloud offline for days. Number of affected customers not published.
who_is_affected: Hugendubel and ebook.de web shop customers and tolino e-reader owners who buy through them. Books already on a device still open; new downloads, sync and Family Sharing do not work. heise reports that other tolino shops such as Thalia are not affected.

known.text: A Hugendubel spokesperson told dpa it was a hacker attack in the night of Nov 18 to 19.
The company's own notices call it a 'technical disruption' and do not mention an attack.
The web shop, the tolino cloud and the service center are offline.
Tolino cloud downloads of books not already on a device, reading-progress sync and Family Sharing do not work.
Free return labels can't be created for now, and Hugendubel has extended the return deadline.
ebook.de, a second shop run by the same Hugendubel company, shows the same outage notice.

not_known.text: When the shop and tolino cloud will be back.
